profile.name: Abdul Hameed Sohail
profile.headline: Hi, I am Abdul Hameed Sohail
profile.subhead: I build Power BI dashboards and Microsoft Fabric pipelines that stand up to stakeholder scrutiny. In under a year, I shipped 3 enterprise BI modules for Himalaya Wellness Company across Finance, Retail, and IT.

about.title: Turning numbers into decisions
paragraphs: Business Intelligence Analyst with 1 year of experience building enterprise Power BI dashboards and data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Dataflow Gen2, Direct Lake, Semantic Models).

Delivered 3 multi-module BI solutions for Himalaya Wellness Company across Finance, Retail, and IT, with expertise in DAX optimization, star-schema modeling, SSMS data validation, and stakeholder reporting.
highlights: Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and SSMS workflow

projects.title: Projects I've built
projects.subtitle: Client dashboards are described here as case studies, metrics and approaches are real, confidential client data has been omitted.

caseStudies.title: FB Dubai: Finance BI Dashboard
caseStudies.description: Finance reporting suite for the Dubai operations of Himalaya Wellness Company, built on Power BI and Microsoft Fabric for the finance team.
bullets: Developed and customized financial reports per client requirements
Optimized DAX and data models; corrected KPI definitions
Eliminated discrepancies flagged during UAT
Implemented dynamic slicers and parameter-driven visuals for self-service filtering
Reduced ad-hoc report requests from finance stakeholders
caseStudies.problem: Financial reports had to match client requirements exactly, but KPI definitions had drifted from source data and discrepancies were flagged during UAT. Finance stakeholders also depended on ad-hoc requests instead of self-service access.
caseStudies.approach: Developed and customized financial reports per client requirements, optimized DAX and data models, and corrected KPI definitions to eliminate discrepancies flagged during UAT. Implemented dynamic slicers and parameter-driven visuals so finance stakeholders could filter reports themselves.
caseStudies.impact: Eliminated discrepancies flagged during UAT and reduced ad-hoc report requests by enabling self-service filtering for finance stakeholders.

howBuilt.schemaLabel: Corrected KPI definitions and optimized the DAX and data model so financial reports matched client requirements.
howBuilt.drillThrough: Drill-through pages were developed in Direct Lake mode for granular transaction-level insights.

caseStudies.title: Retail Analytics Dashboard
caseStudies.description: Retail analytics dashboard tracking sales and inventory for Himalaya Wellness Company, with a refined star-schema model and validated data quality.
bullets: Refined pre-built reports by restructuring measures, calculated columns, and star-schema relationships
Validated SSMS data against Power BI outputs for full data integrity
Performed end-to-end data quality checks on sales and inventory datasets
Identified and resolved calculation inconsistencies before production deployment
caseStudies.problem: Pre-built retail reports carried inconsistent measures and relationships, so sales and inventory figures did not line up with the data validated in SSMS.
caseStudies.approach: Refined the pre-built reports by restructuring measures, calculated columns, and star-schema relationships. Validated SSMS data against Power BI outputs, and performed end-to-end data quality checks on retail sales and inventory datasets.
caseStudies.impact: Identified and resolved calculation inconsistencies before production deployment, ensuring full data integrity across retail reports.

howBuilt.schemaLabel: Restructured measures, calculated columns, and star-schema relationships so Power BI outputs matched SSMS data.
howBuilt.drillThrough: Drill-through pages were developed in Direct Lake mode for granular transaction-level insights.

caseStudies.title: FB IT: IT Operations Dashboard
caseStudies.description: IT operations dashboard for Himalaya Wellness Company, fixing the Galaxy model and enabling drill-through in Direct Lake mode.
bullets: Fixed Galaxy Model relationship and filter-direction issues across 10+ tables
Developed drill-through pages in Direct Lake mode
Validated directional data flow end-to-end against source definitions
Documented report logic, filter hierarchy, and data flow for future maintenance
caseStudies.problem: The IT operations semantic model had Galaxy model filter-direction and relationship issues across 10+ tables, causing cross-filter conflicts that broke accurate data aggregation.
caseStudies.approach: Fixed the Galaxy model's relationship and filter-direction issues across 10+ tables and developed drill-through pages in Direct Lake mode for granular transaction-level insights.
caseStudies.impact: Restored accurate data aggregation, with directional data flow validated end-to-end against source definitions.

howBuilt.schemaLabel: Resolved Galaxy model relationship and filter-direction issues across 10+ shared tables.
howBuilt.drillThrough: Drill-through pages run in Direct Lake mode for transaction-level insights.
